title: Vibrant Rhubarb Bowl
description: A refreshing and healthy bowl filled with the sweetness of rhubarb, the crunch of vibrant vegetables, and the zing of zesty lemon.
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the rhubarb, carrots, and bell peppers.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice and Arabic spices.
Pour the lemon mixture over the vegetables and toss to coat.
Transfer the mixture to a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Serve the roasted vegetables in bowls and drizzle with honey, if desired.
